cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Bring that empty box to my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What do you need it for?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. At present, to establish whether you'll bring it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Take it back without the question this time.

mechanism: A judges whether B questions are permissible while issuing purposeless back-and-forth errands as tests of authority.
confusable: Ordinary delegation has a task outcome; D59 makes the inconvenience itself a test of submission.
comparison: A pointless box round trip differs from adding personal coat service to a cold team test.
seedUse: Retain D59-a box sequence: its response to questioning and compliance already sustains S01 rather than merely naming rank.
